name: Seeking Caitlin
summary: In Menethil Harbor, an alchemist waits for word about a rare grass. She asks you to find Caitlin Grassman, whose husband has not reported back from an excavation.

sections.title: A Missing Report
sections.body:
The alchemist heard from Caitlin that her husband's excavation team found signs of a primordial grass. Caitlin does not know how much they found or whether it can be reached.

Now the alchemist asks you to speak with Caitlin in Menethil Harbor. Both women are waiting to learn what happened to the promised seeds.

faq.answer: Caitlin Grassman is an alchemist in Menethil Harbor. Her husband joined an excavation team that found signs of a primordial grass.

faq.q: What does the alchemist want me to do?
faq.answer: The alchemist asks you to speak with Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.

faq.q: What did the excavation team find?
faq.answer: The team found signs of a long-lost primordial grass. How much there is and whether it can be reached remain unknown.
Caitlin promised the alchemist that her husband would bring back grass seeds, but none have arrived. Both women suspect trouble at the excavation site.

angles.text: As an herbalist, you are asked to check on Caitlin after her husband's team found signs of a rare primordial grass.
